I am an old man, 58 years, and I farm here in Amhara on my small piece of land. This rice plot is only a quarter hectare, and rice needs much water, so I grow it in the low wet place where water stays after the meher rains. I will put some DAP and urea if the cooperative brings it in time, but not too much because it is costly and I must share with my other plots. I use the seed I saved from last year, my sons help me with the work, and I do not have money for pesticide or to hire many people.
